{{Top|leg}}
The '''vertha''' were small predators from the planet [[Morseer]]. They were an example of classic enameled dentition that arose on a methane-shrouded world. Their enamel had a bluish coloration, possibly used as camouflage on a world where native "vegetation" was barely recognizable as such by Human standards.
